subject: Re: Project Saffron kickoff — resourcing
body:
Priya,

Saffron resourcing:

Staffing — Carmen 50% (research lead, bake-off design), Yara 30% (eval slices), Milan 50% and Paloma 40% on Shipyard serving + quantization. That mix holds through the LRB pre-read.

Compute — bake-off inference for the 10.7B MT model needs 64 A100s on titan best-effort for roughly two weeks in May; no reservation required. If we later fine-tune the 7b-mt-bt variant on internal parallel data, that becomes a vulcan-h100 ask and I'll go through Ines with at least three weeks notice.

Serving — Zeke's team confirmed Shipyard staging capacity for one model at a time; the bake-off runs offline, so that's fine.

One flag: the 256k vocab makes naive int8 quantization of the embedding table painful; Milan is scoping it this sprint before we commit to latency numbers.

Bruno
